ADMIT/IN-VIO.note: Recorded as ADMIT/IN-VIO. The IN-VIO suffix is read as in violation; the dataset does not define the ADMIT prefix.

CURED/IN-VIO.note: Recorded as CURED/IN-VIO. The IN-VIO suffix is read as in violation; the dataset does not define the CURED prefix.

DEFAULT.note: Recorded as DEFAULT. The meaning of DEFAULT is not documented in the ECB or OATH dataset dictionaries. It is grouped as upheld_by_default, kept apart from upheld, and is not presented as a decision on the merits.

POP/IN-VIO.note: Recorded as POP/IN-VIO. The IN-VIO suffix is read as in violation; the meaning of POP is not documented.

STIPULATION/IN-VIO.note: Recorded as STIPULATION/IN-VIO. The IN-VIO suffix is read as in violation; the dataset does not define the STIPULATION prefix.

WRITTEN OFF.note: Recorded as WRITTEN OFF. The meaning is not documented. It is not read as upheld or dismissed.

versions.statement: An ECB summons is a charge that DOB issued. It is not by itself a finding that a violation occurred. The correction status is DOB's; the hearing status is OATH's record as published by DOB, grouped by this project's mapping (not DOB's or OATH's), and the certification status is the respondent's certification with DOB. They are shown separately and never combined.

ADMIT/IN-VIO.note: Recorded as ADMIT/IN-VIO. The dataset does not define ADMIT. OATH and DOB guidance describe admitting the violation and paying the penalty before the hearing. It is not presented as a hearing officer's decision after a contested hearing.

CURED/IN-VIO.note: Recorded as CURED/IN-VIO. The dataset does not define CURED. OATH and DOB guidance describe a cure as correcting the condition and filing a certificate of correction before the hearing, which admits the charge, with no penalty. It is not presented as a hearing officer's decision after a contested hearing.

DEFAULT.note: Recorded as DEFAULT. Its meaning is not documented in the ECB or OATH dataset dictionaries. OATH's rules and guidance say a party who misses the hearing is found in violation by default, with a higher penalty, and may ask OATH to vacate the default. The record does not say whether a default was later vacated. It is not a decision on the merits.

IN VIOLATION.note: Recorded as IN VIOLATION, read as OATH's finding that the violation occurred. The dataset does not say how the hearing was held or whether the charge was contested.

POP/IN-VIO.note: Recorded as POP/IN-VIO. The meaning of POP is not documented, so how the IN-VIO outcome was reached is unknown. It is not presented as a hearing officer's decision after a contested hearing.

STIPULATION/IN-VIO.note: Recorded as STIPULATION/IN-VIO. The dataset does not define STIPULATION. In the project's OATH cross-check (33 summonses, 2026-10-23), OATH recorded each as STIPULATED, not IN VIOLATION. OATH and DOB guidance describe a stipulation as an agreement with DOB before the hearing that admits the violation, usually for a reduced penalty and time to correct. It is not presented as a hearing officer's decision after a contested hearing.

WRITTEN OFF.note: Recorded as WRITTEN OFF. The meaning is not documented. It is not read as upheld or dismissed.

versions.statement: An ECB summons is a charge that DOB issued. It is not by itself a finding that a violation occurred. The correction status is DOB's; the hearing status is OATH's record as published by DOB, grouped by this project's mapping (not DOB's or OATH's), and the certification status is the respondent's certification with DOB. They are shown separately and never combined. Only an IN VIOLATION hearing status is counted as upheld; outcomes reached by stipulation, admission, cure, default or an undocumented route are counted separately and are not hearing decisions on the merits.
